sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐藏她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 然后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: First came the seizures and sleep paralysis.
sentences.zh: 首先出现的是癫痫发作和睡眠瘫痪。

sentences.en: Then came the hallucinations and violent behaviour.
sentences.zh: 接着是幻觉和暴力行为。

sentences.en: Annalise McKell made endless visits to doctors and specialists, only to be either referred to another doctor, or placed under medication that wasn't helping her.
sentences.zh: 安娜丽丝·麦凯尔无数次拜访医生和专家，结果却只是被转诊给另一位医生，或是服用对她毫无帮助的药物。

sentences.en: Her condition became so bad, that at times she started to growl, and speak in a horrific deep voice, destroy religious objects,
sentences.zh: 她的病情变得如此严重，以至于有时她开始低吼，用可怕的低沉声音说话，毁坏宗教物品，

sentences.en: and complain religious sites like churches were too painful for her to go near.
sentences.zh: 并抱怨教堂等宗教场所让她感到痛苦，无法靠近。

sentences.en: She convinced her parents and several priests she was possessed by demons.
sentences.zh: 她让她的父母和几位神父确信她被恶魔附身了。

sentences.en: It led to the Catholic Church making the unusual decision to grant two priests permission to perform an exorcism ritual on Annalise.
sentences.zh: 这导致天主教会做出了一个不寻常的决定，批准两名神父为安娜丽丝执行驱魔仪式。

sentences.en: I know what you're thinking.
sentences.zh: 我知道你在想什么。

sentences.en: This story must be from the Dark Ages.
sentences.zh: 这个故事一定发生在黑暗的中世纪。

sentences.en: But it's not.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It happened in Germany, in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 它发生在20世纪70年代的德国。

sentences.en: But was Annalise really possessed by the devil?
sentences.zh: 但安娜丽丝真的被魔鬼附身了吗？

sentences.en: The medical community doesn't think so.
sentences.zh: 医学界并不这么认为。

sentences.en: After her death, they were certain of what Annalise was suffering from.
sentences.zh: 在她死后，他们确信安娜丽丝患的是什么病。

sentences.en: They just couldn't diagnose it while she was alive.
sentences.zh: 只是她在世时他们没能诊断出来。

sentences.en: Four people were eventually charged with negligent homicide after her death.
sentences.zh: 在她死后，最终有四人被指控犯有过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: The trial that followed was described as the biggest criminal trial in Germany, outside of the Nazi war crime trials.
sentences.zh: 随后的审判被描述为德国除纳粹战犯审判之外最大的刑事审判。

sentences.en: The story of Annalise McKell is as heartbreaking as it is horrific.
sentences.zh: 安娜丽丝·麦凯尔的故事既令人心碎又骇人听闻。

sentences.en: Incredibly, some of the exorcism rituals were actually recorded.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是，一些驱魔仪式实际上被录音了。

sentences.en: The tapes were never allowed to be played in court.
sentences.zh: 这些磁带从未被允许在法庭上播放。

sentences.en: But you'll hear some of them in this show.
sentences.zh: 但你将在本节目中听到其中的一些内容。

sentences.en: Annalise McKell was born on the 21st of September 1952.
sentences.zh: 安娜丽丝·麦凯尔出生于1952年9月21日。

sentences.en: Her parents, Anna and Joseph McKell, were devout Catholics from Klingenberg in Germany.
sentences.zh: 她的父母安娜和约瑟夫·麦凯尔是来自德国克林根堡的虔诚天主教徒。

sentences.en: Joseph and Anna had an older daughter, Martha, who died at just eight years of age due to complications that arose during an operation she had to remove a tumour from her kidney.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫和安娜有一个大女儿玛莎，她在年仅八岁时就夭折了，原因是在她做切除肾脏肿瘤手术时出现了并发症。

sentences.en: Along with Annalise, Anna and Joseph gave birth to three other daughters.
sentences.zh: 除了安娜丽丝，安娜和约瑟夫还生了另外三个女儿。

sentences.en: Gertrude, Barbara and Roswita.
sentences.zh: 格特鲁德、芭芭拉和罗丝维塔。

sentences.en: Both Joseph and Anna came from strict Catholic families.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫和安娜都来自严格的天主教家庭。

sentences.en: Joseph's mother actually hoped he would become a prieSt.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫的母亲其实希望他能成为一名神父。

sentences.en: Instead, Joseph would go on to fight in World War II, where he actually became a prisoner of war.
sentences.zh: 相反，约瑟夫后来参加了第二次世界大战，并在战争中成为了一名战俘。

sentences.en: When the war was over, he went on to take over the family sawmill business.
sentences.zh: 战争结束后，他接管了家族的锯木厂生意。

sentences.en: By all accounts, Joseph was loving and caring towards his children, but he had that cold, hard, emotionally vacant stare that many veterans have.
sentences.zh: 据各方所述，约瑟夫对他的孩子们充满了爱心和关怀，但他有着许多退伍军人那种冷酷、严厉、毫无情感波动的眼神。

sentences.en: At times, this left him being distant and unable to display affection or emotion.
sentences.zh: 有时，这让他显得冷漠，无法表现出慈爱或情感。

sentences.en: He was most likely affected by what we know today as PTSD.
sentences.zh: 他很可能受到了我们今天所知的创伤后应激障碍的影响。

sentences.en: Anna was an extremely religious, strict and protective parent.
sentences.zh: 安娜是一个极其宗教化、严厉且有保护欲的家长。

sentences.en: Some have gone as far to describe her as overbearing and suffocating.
sentences.zh: 有人甚至用专横和令人窒息来形容她。

sentences.en: The girls were controlled in every aspect of their lives and were forbidden to mingle with boys.
sentences.zh: 这些女孩生活的方方面面都受到控制，被禁止与男孩交往。

sentences.en: Anna and Joseph both determined what the girls would wear, what they could read, what they could talk about, and so on.
sentences.zh: 安娜和约瑟夫共同决定女孩们穿什么、读什么、聊什么，诸如此类。

sentences.en: It was a very controlled, suppressive household.
sentences.zh: 这是一个控制欲极强、压抑的家庭。

sentences.en: Having said that, it's important to remember
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，重要的是要记住

sentences.en: Anna and Joseph grew up in and lived through a different time.
sentences.zh: 安娜和约瑟夫在不同的时代长大并经历了那个时代。

sentences.en: Post-World War I Germany was tough enough, but then you add in the rise and fall of the Nazi regime and all the horrors that came along with that,
sentences.zh: 一战后的德国已经够艰难了，再加上纳粹政权的兴衰以及随之而来的种种恐怖，

sentences.en: and it's something none of us will ever be able to understand.
sentences.zh: 这是我们任何人永远都无法理解的。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise was described as a very good student who excelled in her studies.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯被描述为一个非常优秀的学生，学业成绩优异。

sentences.en: She was friendly, happy, playful.
sentences.zh: 她很友好、快乐、爱玩。

sentences.en: She liked to sing and play the accordion and piano.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢唱歌，弹手风琴和钢琴。

sentences.en: She was well-behaved, generous, described as just like any other normal girl her age.
sentences.zh: 她表现良好，慷慨大方，被形容得就像她这个年龄的其他正常女孩一样。

sentences.en: Here's a snippet of Anna-Lise talking.
sentences.zh: 这里有一小段安娜-莉斯说话的音频。

sentences.en: I've got no idea what she's saying, it's in German, but it just gives you a snapshot of what she was like, how normal she sounded.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她在说什么，这是德语的，但这只是让你大致了解她是什么样的人，她的声音听起来多么正常。

sentences.en: Yeah, I feel like it's for the other people, so that I don't get in the way to come.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这是为了别人，这样我就不会挡路了。

sentences.en: But that it's so nice and so grave, and so frustrating.
sentences.zh: 但这是如此美好、庄严，又如此令人沮丧。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Church was a big part of the family's life.
sentences.zh: 教堂是这个家庭生活的重要部分。

sentences.en: They visited church every Sunday, and sometimes again on weekdays.
sentences.zh: 他们每个星期天都去教堂，有时工作日也会去。

sentences.en: It was common for the entire family to pray together at home, and the girls would always say a morning and evening prayer.
sentences.zh: 全家人经常在家一起祈祷，女孩们总是要做早祷和晚祷。

sentences.en: When Anna-Lise was 16 years old, she experienced her first seizure.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯16岁时，经历了她的第一次癫痫发作。

sentences.en: She was in class and completely blacked out.
sentences.zh: 她在课堂上完全失去了知觉。

sentences.en: She went into a trance-like state for a brief period.
sentences.zh: 她在短时间内进入了类似精神恍惚的状态。

sentences.en: Despite giving her friends a scare,
sentences.zh: 尽管吓坏了她的朋友们，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise quickly laughed it off and blamed it on being overtired.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯很快一笑了之，并将其归咎于过度疲劳。

sentences.en: She didn't think too much more of it until about midnight that night.
sentences.zh: 直到那天午夜左右，她才没再多想。

sentences.en: At midnight, Anna-Lise describes waking up in bed but being unable to move.
sentences.zh: 午夜时分，安娜-莉斯描述说她在床上醒来，但无法动弹。

sentences.en: It felt as though something was pinning her down.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像有什么东西把她死死按住。

sentences.en: She struggled to breathe, she couldn't speak, she couldn't cry out, she couldn't move at all.
sentences.zh: 她呼吸困难，无法说话，无法呼喊，完全动弹不得。

sentences.en: The frightening incident didn't last long, and many cite this as the first signs of Anna-Lise becoming possessed.
sentences.zh: 这次可怕的事件并没有持续多久，许多人认为这是安娜-莉斯开始被附身的最初迹象。

sentences.en: But as somebody who has experienced some bouts of sleep paralysis before, I can tell you that is exactly what Anna-Lise was describing.
sentences.zh: 但作为曾经经历过几次睡眠瘫痪的人，我可以告诉你，这正是安娜-莉斯所描述的那样。

sentences.en: It's exactly how it feels.
sentences.zh: 这正是那种感觉。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise didn't go to school the next day, however, it appeared to be just a one-off.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯第二天没有去学校，然而，这似乎只是一次性的事件。

sentences.en: The next day and night were uneventful, as were the following weeks and months.
sentences.zh: 接下来的白天和黑夜都很平静，随后的几周和几个月也是如此。

sentences.en: She slowly forgot about the incident, and life returned back to normal for almost a year.
sentences.zh: 她渐渐淡忘了这件事，生活恢复了正常，持续了近一年。

sentences.en: When she was 17,
sentences.zh: 在她17岁时，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise experienced her second seizure.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯经历了她的第二次癫痫发作。

sentences.en: It was identical to at first, where she blacked out and momentarily went into a trance-like state.
sentences.zh: 这与第一次完全一样，她失去了知觉，并短暂地进入了恍惚状态。

sentences.en: And again that night, she had another frightening episode of sleep paralysis, where she was awake, alert to everything going on, but unable to move or speak.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她又经历了一次可怕的睡眠瘫痪，她醒着，对发生的一切都很清醒，但无法动弹或说话。

sentences.en: As it was now the second time this had happened,
sentences.zh: 既然这是第二次发生这种情况，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise went to visit her family doctor,
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯去拜访了她的家庭医生，

sentences.en: Dr. Vok.
sentences.zh: 沃克医生。

sentences.en: He immediately referred her to a specialist,
sentences.zh: 他立即将她转诊给了一位专家，

sentences.en: Dr. Luthie, who was a neurologiSt.
sentences.zh: 神经科医生露丝医生。

sentences.en: Dr. Luthie performed a number of tests, but they all came back negative.
sentences.zh: 露丝医生做了多项检查，但结果全部呈阴性。

sentences.en: The EEG test, which is a test that tracks and records brainwave patterns, showed Anna-Lise had normal brainwave activity.
sentences.zh: 脑电图是一种追踪和记录脑电波模式的测试，结果显示安娜-莉斯的脑电波活动正常。

sentences.en: Dr. Luthie couldn't determine anything wrong from a neurological or psychological perspective.
sentences.zh: 露丝医生从神经学或心理学的角度无法确定有什么问题。

sentences.en: Dr. Luthie suspected Anna-Lise was suffering from cerebral seizures and was possibly displaying symptoms of epilepsy.
sentences.zh: 露丝医生怀疑安娜-莉斯患有脑部癫痫发作，并可能表现出癫痫的症状。

sentences.en: Dr. Luthie didn't prescribe any medication, as there had only been two incidents and they were spread out about a year apart.
sentences.zh: 露丝医生没有开任何药物，因为总共只发作过两次，而且间隔约有一年之久。

sentences.en: Soon after this,
sentences.zh: 这之后不久，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise's physical health started to go downhill.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯的身体健康开始走下坡路。

sentences.en: She suffered bouts of tonsillitis, pleurisy and pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 她患上了扁桃体炎、胸膜炎和肺炎。

sentences.en: The illnesses were bad enough, they forced her to miss school.
sentences.zh: 这些疾病相当严重，迫使她缺课。

sentences.en: Away from her school friends,
sentences.zh: 远离了学校的朋友们，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise was confined mostly to her bedroom, with her overbearing strict parents looking after her.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯大部分时间都被关在卧室里，由她专横严厉的父母照顾。

sentences.en: At home, Anna-Lise wasn't allowed to disagree with her parents or express any individuality.
sentences.zh: 在家裡，安娜-莉斯不允许反驳父母或表达任何个性。

sentences.en: Whenever there was a disagreement, her mother Anna would simply ignore her and just pray loudly over the top of her.
sentences.zh: 每当发生分歧时，她的母亲安娜就会直接忽视她，并在她头上大声祈祷盖过她的声音。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise's health didn't improve and on the 28th of February 1970, she was admitted to hospital.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯的健康状况没有改善，1970年2月28日，她被送往医院。

sentences.en: Doctors soon discovered Anna-Lise was also suffering from heart and circulation problems and she was transferred to another hospital.
sentences.zh: 医生很快发现安娜-莉斯还患有心脏和循环系统问题，于是她被转到另一家医院。

sentences.en: These were environments completely different to what she was used to at home.
sentences.zh: 这些环境与她在家里习惯的环境完全不同。

sentences.en: She struggled to interact with other teenagers in the hospitals and she felt isolated, became depressed and withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 她在医院里难以与其他青少年互动，感到孤立无援，变得抑郁和孤僻。

sentences.en: Other teenagers in the hospital started giving her a hard time and making her life a misery.
sentences.zh: 医院里的其他青少年开始找她的麻烦，使她的生活苦不堪言。

sentences.en: Some referred to her as snot-nose.
sentences.zh: 有人称她为鼻涕虫。

sentences.en: On the 3rd of June 1970, she suffered her third sleep paralysis episode.
sentences.zh: 1970年6月3日，她经历了第三次睡眠瘫痪发作。

sentences.en: When it was over, she screamed, causing nurses to come rushing to her aid.
sentences.zh: 结束后，她尖叫起来，引得护士们赶来救援。

sentences.en: But as far as they could tell, she was fine.
sentences.zh: 但据他们所知，她很好。

sentences.en: This little episode didn't go down well with her fellow patients.
sentences.zh: 这个小插曲并没有给她招来病友们的喜爱。

sentences.en: They already didn't like her.
sentences.zh: 他们本来就不喜欢她。

sentences.en: Some started making fun of her, saying she was possessed by the devil.
sentences.zh: 有些人开始取笑她，说她被魔鬼附身了。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise relied on her faith to get her through these tough times.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯依靠她的信仰度过了这些艰难的时光。

sentences.en: She was extremely religious and still prayed many times a day.
sentences.zh: 她极其虔诚，每天仍然多次祈祷。

sentences.en: Once, when praying the rosary in hospital, she reported smelling a sweet odour and having a euphoric feeling.
sentences.zh: 有一次，在医院里念玫瑰经时，她报告说闻到了一股甜美的气味，并有一种欣快感。

sentences.en: She became convinced she had been touched by the Virgin Mary.
sentences.zh: 她确信自己得到了圣母玛利亚的触摸。

sentences.en: On the 16th of June 1970,
Anna-Lise was referred to another neurologist,
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯被转诊给另一位神经科医生，

sentences.en: Dr. Von Heller.
sentences.zh: 冯·海勒医生。

sentences.en: Dr. Von Heller ran another series of tests, including another EEG teSt.
sentences.zh: 冯·海勒医生进行了另一系列检查，包括另一次脑电图检查。

sentences.en: He found irregularities in Anna-Lise's brainwave patterns.
sentences.zh: 他发现安娜-莉斯的脑电波模式存在异常。

sentences.en: He prescribed her any seizure medication, the same medication given to people with epilepsy.
sentences.zh: 他给她开了抗癫痫药物，也就是给癫痫患者服用的同类药物。

sentences.en: All Anna-Lise wanted to do was experience that same feeling she had just gotten back when praying the rosary, but she couldn't get that feeling back.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯唯一想做的事就是重现她刚才在念玫瑰经时得到的同一种感觉，但她再也找不回那种感觉了。

sentences.en: She rationalised this by saying the Virgin Mary was busy helping other people, but maybe the medication she was now taking had something to do with it.
sentences.zh: 她对此的合理解释是圣母玛利亚正忙着帮助其他人，但也可能是她现在服用的药物与之有关。

sentences.en: But several weeks after seeing Dr. Von Heller and taking the medication, other symptoms started to develop.
sentences.zh: 但在见到冯·海勒医生并服药几周后，其他症状开始出现。

sentences.en: She reported seeing a demonic-looking face when saying the rosary.
sentences.zh: 她报告说在念玫瑰经时看到了一个恶魔般的面孔。

sentences.en: Then it started to develop to the point where she would see demonic faces regularly, not necessarily just when she was praying.
sentences.zh: 然后情况发展到她会经常看到恶魔的面孔，不一定仅仅是在她祈祷的时候。

sentences.en: It's important to note she did not start seeing these faces until after being placed on the anti-seizure medication.
sentences.zh: 需要注意的是，直到开始服用抗癫痫药物之后，她才开始看到这些面孔。

sentences.en: Whilst the medication had stopped the seizures and the sleep paralysis episodes, she was now starting to hallucinate and see demonic faces.
sentences.zh: 虽然药物已经停止了癫痫发作和睡眠瘫痪的发作，但她现在开始出现幻觉并看到恶魔的面孔。

sentences.en: The medical explanation is that
sentences.zh: 医学上的解释是

sentences.en: Anna-Lise was experiencing epilepsy-related hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯正在经历与癫痫相关的幻觉。

sentences.en: Despite these new symptoms developing, her actual physical health, the heart and circulation problems, had improved and Anna-Lise was discharged from hospital
sentences.zh: 尽管这些新症状出现，她的实际身体健康状况——心脏和循环系统问题——已经有所改善，安娜-莉斯于1970年8月29日出院

sentences.en: and sent home on the 29th of August, 1970.
sentences.zh: 并被送回家中。

sentences.en: Everybody noticed a change in Anna-Lise when she returned home.
sentences.zh: 每个人都注意到安娜-莉斯回家后的变化。

sentences.en: She was now irritable and always unhappy.
sentences.zh: 她现在变得易怒且一直不高兴。

sentences.en: She would display sudden outbursts of anger for no apparent reason, and these got more frequent and more violent as time went on.
sentences.zh: 她会无缘无故地突然爆发愤怒，随着时间的推移，这些愤怒变得越来越频繁，越来越暴力。

sentences.en: She always seemed distant and moody.
sentences.zh: 她看起来总是冷漠而喜怒无常。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise also started experiencing seizures again.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯也开始再次发作癫痫。

sentences.en: She would freeze up in rigid positions with an angry contorted look on her face.
sentences.zh: 她会僵直在身体僵硬的姿势中，脸上带着愤怒扭曲的表情。

sentences.en: Along with her hallucinations of seeing demonic faces,
sentences.zh: 伴随着她看到恶魔面孔的幻觉，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise was now complaining about rotten smells, described like burning faecal matter, but no one else could smell anything.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯现在开始抱怨腐烂的气味，被形容为像燃烧的粪便，但其他人什么也闻不到。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise's behaviour caused her mother Anna to become even more controlling.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯的行为导致她的母亲安娜变得更具控制欲。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise returned to school, but she was now behind her friends as she had missed an entire school year.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯重返学校，但因为缺了一整年的学，她现在落后于朋友们了。

sentences.en: She tried to reach out to her school friends about her experiences, but they were more interested in teenage girl stuff.
sentences.zh: 她试图向学校的朋友们倾诉她的经历，但他们对十几岁女孩的东西更感兴趣。

sentences.en: This caused Anna-Lise to spiral down even further.
sentences.zh: 这导致安娜-莉斯进一步陷入螺旋式下跌。

sentences.en: She became more withdrawn, and her depression got worse.
sentences.zh: 她变得更加孤僻，抑郁症也加重了。

sentences.en: As a result, her grades started to suffer.
sentences.zh: 结果，她的成绩开始下滑。

sentences.en: Teachers noticed a change in her.
sentences.zh: 老师们注意到了她的变化。

sentences.en: Due to her experiencing seizures again and seeing ever-increasing hallucinations,
sentences.zh: 由于她再次发作癫痫并看到越来越多的幻觉，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise saw another specialist,
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉斯看了另一位专家，

sentences.en: Dr Reichelt.
sentences.zh: 赖歇尔特医生。

sentences.en: Dr Reichelt discovered some more circulatory irregularities and referred her to another specialist,
sentences.zh: 赖歇尔特医生发现了更多的血液循环异常，并把她转诊给另一位专家，

sentences.en: Dr Packhauser.
sentences.zh: 帕克豪泽医生。

sentences.en: Dr Packhauser expressed concern about the seizures and liaised with Anna-Lise's family doctor,
sentences.zh: 帕克豪泽医生对这些癫痫发作表示担忧，并与安娜-莉丝的家庭医生

sentences.en: Dr Vokt, about them.
sentences.zh: 沃克特医生进行了沟通。

sentences.en: They decided Anna-Lise should go back and see Dr Luthie.
sentences.zh: 他们决定让安娜-莉丝回去找露西医生复诊。

sentences.en: Dr Luthie changed her medication and put her onto Centropil.
sentences.zh: 露西医生为她更换了药物，并给她服用了西托派（Centropil）。

sentences.en: It's another anticonvulsant drug.
sentences.zh: 这是另一种抗惊厥药物。

sentences.en: The side effects of Centropil are it may affect the central nervous system and cardiovascular system.
sentences.zh: 西托派的副作用是它可能会影响中枢神经系统和心血管系统。

sentences.en: It can also cause headaches, insomnia, rashes, and it affects the gums and liver.
sentences.zh: 它还会引起头痛、失眠、皮疹，并对牙龈和肝脏产生影响。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise went back for several check-ups with Dr Luthie.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝回去找露西医生做了几次复查。

sentences.en: The last of these series of check-ups was in June 1973.
sentences.zh: 这一系列复查的最后一次是在1973年6月。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise reported the new drug seemed to have stopped the seizures, however, she was still experiencing hallucinations, seeing demonic faces.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝报告说，新药似乎已经制止了癫痫发作，然而，她仍然经历着幻觉，看到了恶魔的面孔。

sentences.en: However, Dr Luthie's main concern was that the seizures had stopped, so he felt the medication was doing its job.
sentences.zh: 然而，露西医生最关心的是癫痫发作已经停止，所以他觉得药物正在发挥作用。

sentences.en: He performed another EEG test, which revealed Anna-Lise had normal brainwave activity.
sentences.zh: 他进行了另一次脑电图检查，结果显示安娜-莉丝的脑电波活动正常。

sentences.en: But the hallucinations got worse.
sentences.zh: 但幻觉变得更严重了。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise started to hear knocking sounds.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝开始听到敲击声。

sentences.en: She reported these were coming from inside her closet, from the floor, and from the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 她报告说这些声音来自她的衣柜里面、地板上以及天花板上。

sentences.en: This resulted in yet another visit to another specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 这导致她不得不再次去看另一位专家。

sentences.en: This time it was a hearing specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 这一次是一位听力专家。

sentences.en: He ran some tests, but couldn't find anything wrong with Anna-Lise.
sentences.zh: 他做了一些检查，但没有发现安娜-莉丝有什么问题。

sentences.en: By now, Anna-Lise had just about had it with the medical community.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，安娜-莉丝对医学界已经彻底失望了。

sentences.en: Despite constant doctor's visits, all doctors ever seemed to be able to do was either refer her to another doctor, or put her under any convulsant medication,
sentences.zh: 尽管频繁看医生，但所有医生似乎能做的要么是把她转诊给另一个医生，要么是给她服用任何抗惊厥药物，

sentences.en: which was doing nothing to help her hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 而这对她的幻觉毫无帮助。

sentences.en: Nobody seemed to be able to give her a definitive diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有人能给她一个明确的诊断。

sentences.en: And remember, Anna-Lise's older sister died when she was just eight.
sentences.zh: 而且请记住，安娜-莉丝的姐姐在她只有八岁时就去世了。

sentences.en: Died as a result of complications arising from a medical procedure.
sentences.zh: 死于医疗程序引起的并发症。

sentences.en: So Anna-Lise and her family already had a certain mistrust of doctors, and their recent experiences weren't exactly restoring the faith.
sentences.zh: 因此，安娜-莉丝和她的家人对医生已经有了一种不信任感，而他们最近的经历并没有确切地恢复这种信心。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise started to become convinced there was a greater power at work, and the reason doctors couldn't help her
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝开始坚信有一股更强大的力量在起作用，医生无法帮助她的原因

sentences.en: is because she was being made to suffer for a greater spiritual reason.
sentences.zh: 是因为她正在为了某种更高的精神原因而承受痛苦。

sentences.en: So around this time,
sentences.zh: 所以在大约这个时候，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise started to behave strangely around holy objects.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝在圣物周围开始表现得很奇怪。

sentences.en: She displayed the first signs of resentment towards the Catholic Church and towards religious symbols.
sentences.zh: 她表现出了对天主教会和宗教象征的抵触情绪的最初迹象。

sentences.en: This was unusual for the extremely religious, devout Catholic girl.
sentences.zh: 这对于这个极其宗教化、虔诚的天主教女孩来说很不寻常。

sentences.en: Her mother Anna reported that one time she walked in on Anna-Lise staring at a statue of the Virgin Mary.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲安娜报告说，有一次她撞见安娜-莉丝盯着圣母玛利亚的雕像。

sentences.en: Anna described Anna-Lise as having jet black eyes and a look of extreme hatred on her face.
sentences.zh: 安娜形容安娜-莉丝当时有着漆黑的眼睛，脸上一副极端仇恨的表情。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise started to complain about praying and that she couldn't attend church as it was painful trying to get through the entrance.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝开始抱怨祈祷，说她不能去教堂，因为穿过入口对她来说是一种痛苦。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise's father Joseph organised a trip to San Damiano.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝的父亲约瑟夫组织了一次去圣达米亚诺的旅行。

sentences.en: It is a holy site deeply sacred to the Catholic religion, located in Italy.
sentences.zh: 那是位于意大利的一个对天主教具有深远神圣意义的圣地。

sentences.en: It attracts thousands and thousands of visitors every year, and many report experiencing incarnas with the Virgin Mary at the site.
sentences.zh: 它每年吸引成千上万的游客，许多人报告说在那个地方体验到了与圣母玛利亚的显灵。

sentences.en: When they got there, Anna-Lise was unable to enter.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达那里时，安娜-莉丝无法进去。

sentences.en: She said the soil burnt her feet.
sentences.zh: 她说泥土灼烧着她的脚。

sentences.en: Joseph bought her a holy medal, however Anna-Lise said she couldn't wear it as it pressed against her chest, stopping her from breathing.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫给她买了一枚圣牌，然而安娜-莉丝说她不能戴，因为它压迫着她的胸口，使她无法呼吸。

sentences.en: Despite her worsening condition,
sentences.zh: 尽管她的病情恶化，

sentences.en: Anna-Lise graduated from high school and commenced college in 1973.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝还是从高中毕业，并于1973年开始上大学。

sentences.en: She was studying to become a teacher.
sentences.zh: 她正在学习成为一名教师。

sentences.en: But the once bright, energetic student really struggled with the work.
sentences.zh: 但这个曾经聪明的、充满活力的学生在学业上遇到了极大的困难。

sentences.en: She couldn't pay attention in class and she even struggled to get out of bed to attend class.
sentences.zh: 她在课堂上无法集中注意力，甚至挣扎着起床去上课。

sentences.en: She was spiralling into a severe bout of depression and started to contemplate suicide.
sentences.zh: 她正陷入严重的抑郁发作，并开始考虑自杀。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise was still suffering from hallucinations of demonic faces and extreme smells.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝仍然遭受着恶魔面孔和极端的异味的幻觉折磨。

sentences.en: In September 1973,
Anna-Lise met with Dr. Luthie again.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝再次见到了露西医生。

sentences.en: Anna-Lise told Dr. Luthie the devil was inside her and judgment of fire would be visited upon everyone.
sentences.zh: 安娜-莉丝告诉露西医生，魔鬼在她体内，烈火的审判将降临到每个人身上。

sentences.en: Dr. Luthie noted in his visit that Anna-Lise appeared obsessed with Satan being inside her.
sentences.zh: 露西医生在这次就诊记录中指出，安娜-莉丝似乎沉迷于撒旦在她体内这一想法。

sentences.en: She appeared disorientated, indecisive and all over the place were the thoughts.
sentences.zh: 她显得迷失方向、优柔寡断，思绪一片混乱。

sentences.en: He believed her condition was so bad that she was incapable of making decisions for herself.
sentences.zh: 他认为她的病情如此严重，以至于她无法为自己做出决定。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: There are a couple of contentious points here.
sentences.zh: 这里有几个有争议的点。

sentences.en: The first being,
sentences.zh: 第一个是，

sentences.en: Anna swears Dr. Luthie suggested to them that Anna-Lise may be suffering from demonic possession.
sentences.zh: 安娜发誓露西医生曾向他们暗示，安娜-莉丝可能患有恶魔附身。

sentences.en: And he suggested to go and see a prieSt.
sentences.zh: 并且他建议去见一位神父。

sentences.en: This claim is strongly denied by Dr. Luthie.
sentences.zh: 这一说法遭到露西医生的强烈否认。

sentences.en: The second point, and one that's often overlooked in the story of Anna-Lise McKell, is that 1971 was when The Exorcist novel was released.
sentences.zh: 第二点，也是在安娜-莉丝·麦凯勒的故事中经常被忽视的一点，是1971年正是小说《驱魔人》出版的时候。

sentences.en: The novel was then made into a movie in 1973 that got its release in Germany in 1974, which is right around this time.
sentences.zh: 这部小说随后在1973年被改编成电影，并于1974年在德国上映，这正是在这个时候。

sentences.en: And this wasn't a small-time novel or a movie with just a small cult following.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是一部小众小说，也不是一部只有少数死忠粉丝的电影。

sentences.en: It was a worldwide smash hit.
sentences.zh: 这是一部轰动全球的巨大成功之作。

sentences.en: The book has sold over 13 million copies, and the movie was nominated for 10 Academy Awards, and it won two.
sentences.zh: 这本书售出了超过1300万册，电影获得了10项奥斯卡奖提名，并赢得了两项。

sentences.en: It was the first ever horror movie to be nominated for Best Picture.
sentences.zh: 这是有史以来第一部获得最佳影片提名的恐怖电影。

sentences.en: Some sites report that if an adjustment was made for inflation,
sentences.zh: 一些网站报道称，如果根据通货膨胀进行调整，

sentences.en: The Exorcist would actually be the ninth-highest-grossing movie of all time.
sentences.zh: 《驱魔人》实际上将是有史以来票房收入第九高的电影。

sentences.en: If you're not familiar with the story, briefly it revolves around a young girl who starts showing signs of demonic possession.
sentences.zh: 如果你不熟悉这个故事，简单来说它围绕着一个开始表现出恶魔附身迹象的小女孩展开。

sentences.en: Unable to get any help from the medical community, her mother seeks the help of a priest, and they perform an exorcism.
sentences.zh: 由于无法从医学界得到任何帮助，她的母亲寻求了一位神父的帮助，他们进行了一场驱魔。

sentences.en: The timing of The Exorcist's release is important and something to keep in mind as we move forward.
sentences.zh: 《驱魔人》上映的时机很重要，在我们继续讲述时要牢记这一点。

sentences.en: Annalise continued to get worse.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝的情况继续恶化。

sentences.en: Her mother, Anna, started to become worried what her neighbours and other people in town were thinking and saying about them.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲安娜开始担心她的邻居和镇上的其他人对他们有什么想法和议论。

sentences.en: The never-ending medical visits and reports of hallucinations were starting to generate rumours around town.
sentences.zh: 没完没了的就医和幻觉的报告开始在镇上制造谣言。

sentences.en: The last thing Anna wanted was Annalise to be suffering from a mental illness.
sentences.zh: 安娜最不希望看到的就是安娜莉丝患有精神疾病。

sentences.en: When one of her friends at church suggested that maybe Annalise was suffering demonic possession,
sentences.zh: 当她的一位教堂朋友暗示安娜莉丝可能遭受恶魔附身时，

sentences.en: Anna liked that idea much better than mental illness.
sentences.zh: 安娜觉得这个想法比精神疾病好得多。

sentences.en: Annalise and Anna decided to start seeing a priest as the doctors weren't helping her.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝和安娜决定开始去看神父，因为医生对她没有帮助。

sentences.en: Annalise said the medication was doing nothing but making her feel depressed and tired.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝说这些药物除了让她感到抑郁和疲惫外，什么都没做。

sentences.en: Her hallucinations remained and were getting worse.
sentences.zh: 她的幻觉依然存在并且正在恶化。

sentences.en: Annalise and her parents met with Father Habiger and his associate Father Roth.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝和她的父母会见了哈比格神父和他的助手罗斯神父。

sentences.en: Father Habiger concluded that Annalise seemed entirely normal, maybe a little bit shy, but definitely no suggestion she was possessed.
sentences.zh: 哈比格神父得出结论，安娜莉丝看起来完全正常，也许有点害羞，但绝对没有任何被附身的迹象。

sentences.en: He actually referred her back to her doctors.
sentences.zh: 他实际上把她转诊回了她的医生那里。

sentences.en: Not satisfied with this, they contacted a priest who was an expert in possession,
sentences.zh: 对此不满意，他们联系了一位精通附身的牧师，

sentences.en: Father Rodwick.
sentences.zh: 罗德维克神父。

sentences.en: He became interested in Annalise's case when he heard about what happened on her visit to San Damiano.
sentences.zh: 当他听说安娜莉丝去圣达米亚诺的遭遇后，他开始对安娜莉丝的案子产生兴趣。

sentences.en: He believed that possession was definitely a possibility, however he was now 79 years of age, so he said he was too old to get involved.
sentences.zh: 他认为附身绝对是一种可能，然而他现在已经79岁了，所以他说自己年纪太大而无法参与。

sentences.en: He referred Annalise to another priest,
sentences.zh: 他把安娜莉丝转介给另一位神父，

sentences.en: Father Herman.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼神父。

sentences.en: Father Herman met with Annalise 10 times.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼神父与安娜莉丝会面了10次。

sentences.en: She explained to him the hallucinations, the demonic faces, and her odd behaviour around holy objects and around holy places.
sentences.zh: 她向他解释了幻觉、恶魔面孔，以及她在圣物和圣地周围的奇怪行为。

sentences.en: However, Father Herman found no evidence of possession either.
sentences.zh: 然而，赫尔曼神父也没有发现任何被附身的证据。

sentences.en: They prayed together several times during their meetings, and each time Annalise remained calm and displayed no odd behaviour during prayer or towards any of the holy objects.
sentences.zh: 他们在会面期间一起祈祷了几次，每一次安娜莉丝都保持冷静，在祈祷期间或对任何圣物都没有表现出任何奇怪的行为。

sentences.en: After meeting with her, he suggested she go back and see a neurologiSt.
sentences.zh: 在与她会面后，他建议她回去看神经科医生。

sentences.en: Annalise wasn't happy with this.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝对此并不高兴。

sentences.en: She had already seen several neurologists and no one could seem to help her.
sentences.zh: 她已经看过好几个神经科医生了，似乎没有人能帮到她。

sentences.en: Father Alt was a friend of Father Roth.
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父是罗斯神父的朋友。

sentences.en: Father Roth explained Annalise's case to Father Alt and he immediately became interested.
sentences.zh: 罗斯神父向阿尔特神父解释了安娜莉丝的案子，他立刻产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: Upon hearing about Annalise's case,
sentences.zh: 在听到安娜莉丝的案子后，

sentences.en: Father Alt claims he experienced several strange occurrences.
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父声称他经历了几个奇怪的事件。

sentences.en: He said suddenly, without warning, without explanation, he knew everything about Annalise and her family, despite the fact he had never met any of them before.
sentences.zh: 他说突然之间，毫无预兆，毫无解释，他知道了关于安娜莉丝和她家人的所有事情，尽管事实上他以前从未见过他们中的任何一个人。

sentences.en: He also claimed he started to experience the foul smells and started hearing the knocking noises at night time.
sentences.zh: 他还声称他开始经历恶臭，并开始在夜间听到敲击声。

sentences.en: Throughout this time,
sentences.zh: 在这段期间，

sentences.en: Annalise was still attending college.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝仍在上大学。

sentences.en: By now, she had met Peter, who became her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 到这时，她遇到了彼得，他成了她的男朋友。

sentences.en: Peter stuck by Annalise through these tough times and was determined to help her get better.
sentences.zh: 彼得在这些艰难时期一直陪伴着安娜莉丝，并决心帮助她康复。

sentences.en: It was Peter who convinced Annalise to see yet another doctor.
sentences.zh: 正是彼得说服安娜莉丝去看另一个医生。

sentences.en: Together, they visited Dr. Lenner.
sentences.zh: 他们一起去拜访了莱纳医生。

sentences.en: Dr. Lenner was convinced Annalise was suffering epilepsy.
sentences.zh: 莱纳医生确信安娜莉丝患有癫痫。

sentences.en: So Dr. Lenner referred Annalise to yet another neurologiSt.
sentences.zh: 于是莱纳医生将安娜莉丝转诊给另一位神经科医生。

sentences.en: This time, she saw Dr. Schlepp.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她看了施莱普医生。

sentences.en: Dr. Schlepp performed all the usual tests and discovered irregular brain patterns in the left temporal area of Annalise's brain.
sentences.zh: 施莱普医生做了所有常规检查，发现在安娜莉丝大脑的左颞叶区域有不规律的脑电波模式。

sentences.en: Dr. Schlepp was convinced this was definitive proof of epilepsy and changed Annalise's medication to Tegretol.
sentences.zh: 施莱普医生确信这是癫痫的明确证据，并将安娜莉丝的药物换成了特雷托（Tegretol）。

sentences.en: Tegretol is also an anticonvulsant medication with side effects of fatigue, nausea, dizziness and it can affect the blood.
sentences.zh: 特雷托也是一种抗惊厥药物，其副作用包括疲劳、恶心、头晕，并且会影响血液。

sentences.en: Around this time, Annalise started having physical meetings with Father Olt.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，安娜莉丝开始与奥尔特神父进行实体会面。

sentences.en: She was still seeing demonic faces.
sentences.zh: 她依然能看到恶魔的面孔。

sentences.en: The medication change didn't help.
sentences.zh: 换药并没有起作用。

sentences.en: She did go back and see Dr. Schlepp again where she reported having severe headaches and that she was struggling to get out of bed now and she was always slow and lethargic.
sentences.zh: 她确实回去又看了施莱普医生，并报告说她头痛剧烈，现在连起床都很费劲，而且总是行动迟缓、毫无生气。

sentences.en: She also said that she started to feel as though one side of her body was developing paralysis-like symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 她还说，她开始感到身体的一侧出现了类似瘫痪的症状。

sentences.en: Despite all this, Dr. Schlepp instructed her to keep taking Tegretol and it's around this time Annalise's behaviour really started to spiral out of control.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，施莱普医生还是指示她继续服用特雷托，正是在这个时候，安娜莉丝的行为真正开始失控。

sentences.en: Her angry outbursts were now outright fits of violence and rage.
sentences.zh: 她愤怒的发作现在演变成了彻底的暴力和狂怒的发作。

sentences.en: She destroyed holy objects such as rosary beads and crucifixes.
sentences.zh: 她毁坏了诸如念珠和十字架等圣物。

sentences.en: She smashed pictures of Jesus and the Virgin Mary.
sentences.zh: 她砸碎了耶稣和圣母玛利亚的照片。

sentences.en: She threw objects at her boyfriend Peter and her sisters and tried to bite, punch and kick them at times.
sentences.zh: 她向男友彼得和她的姐妹们投掷物品，有时还试图咬、打和踢他们。

sentences.en: But when she wasn't behaving violently like this she would be in extreme lows.
sentences.zh: 但当她没有这样表现出暴力时，她就会陷入极度的低谷。

sentences.en: She couldn't get out of bed, severely depressed.
sentences.zh: 她无法起床，严重抑郁。

sentences.en: Annalise had several more visits with Dr. Schlepp and each time he told her to keep taking Tegretol.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝又多次拜访了施莱普医生，每次他都告诉她继续服用特雷托。

sentences.en: Annalise was no longer able to visit the church at all.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝再也无法去教堂了。

sentences.en: She said it was too painful to get past the entrance.
sentences.zh: 她说穿过入口太痛苦了。

sentences.en: Annalise was starting to lose all touch with reality.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝开始与现实完全脱节。

sentences.en: She started to behave as different personalities.
sentences.zh: 她开始表现出不同的个性。

sentences.en: The hallucinations were now all too frequent as were her intense fits of rage.
sentences.zh: 幻觉现在变得太频繁了，她强烈的狂怒发作也是如此。

sentences.en: During the rages she wouldn't sleep at all.
sentences.zh: 在狂怒发作期间，她根本不睡觉。

sentences.en: She would display bizarre behaviour like kneeling down violently on the ground then standing straight back up then kneeling down violently on the ground again as hard as she could.
sentences.zh: 她会表现出怪异的行为，比如猛烈地跪在地上，然后马上直立站起，然后又尽可能用力地猛烈跪在地上。

sentences.en: She would repeat this for hours.
sentences.zh: 她会重复这个动作几个小时。

sentences.en: She ran through the house screaming She started eating flies and spiders
sentences.zh: 她在屋里奔跑尖叫，她开始吃苍蝇和蜘蛛

sentences.en: She continued to shatter crucifixes and rosary beads and any other holy objects she could find.
sentences.zh: 她继续砸碎十字架、念珠以及她能找到的任何其他圣物。

sentences.en: She started to growl and make horrific screaMs.
sentences.zh: 她开始咆哮并发出可怕的尖叫。

sentences.en: Father Alt became convinced Annalise was possessed.
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父确信安娜莉丝被附身了。

sentences.en: With the permission of his bishop he started saying exorcism prayers over Annalise.
sentences.zh: 在主教的许可下，他开始对安娜莉丝念驱魔祷文。

sentences.en: This wasn't a full-blown exorcism ritual which would come later.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个全面展开的驱魔仪式，那要在以后才会进行。

sentences.en: These were just prayers described as like a trial exorcism.
sentences.zh: 这些只是被描述为像试探性驱魔一样的祈祷。

sentences.en: During these prayers
sentences.zh: 在这些祈祷期间，

sentences.en: Father Alt says Annalise groud she was burning and then tried to knock the book of prayers out of his hand.
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父说安娜莉丝呻吟着说她在燃烧，然后试图把他手里的祈祷书打掉。

sentences.en: And Annalise started to mention that demons were controlling her.
sentences.zh: 并且安娜莉丝开始提到恶魔在控制她。

sentences.en: The medical community has since described this behaviour as epilepsy with extreme episodes of schizophrenic psychosis.
sentences.zh: 医学界此后将这种行为描述为伴有极度精神分裂症精神病发作的癫痫。

sentences.en: Father Alt described it as demonic possession.
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父则将其描述为恶魔附身。

sentences.en: On the 15th of May 1975 with all this going on
sentences.zh: 1975年5月15日，在发生这一切的同时，

sentences.en: Annalise's grandmother died.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝的祖母去世了。

sentences.en: Annalise was very close to her grandmother and so it was yet another traumatic event.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝与祖母的感情非常深厚，因此这又是一次创伤性的事件。

sentences.en: Annalise didn't always act out in violent fits of rage.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝并不总是表现出暴力的狂怒发作。

sentences.en: Often she would calm down but even when she was calm she would still talk about demons and how they were controlling her and that all she felt was despair and hopelessness.
sentences.zh: 通常她会平静下来，但即使在她平静的时候，她仍然会谈论恶魔以及它们是如何控制她的，并且她感受到的只有绝望和无助。

sentences.en: And on top of that she would say she was not mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，她还会说自己没有精神病。

sentences.en: She made sure to constantly stress that point.
sentences.zh: 她反复强调这一点。

sentences.en: In fact she went on to comment that she feared being diagnosed as mentally ill and that she didn't want to go to a mental hospital.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她接着评论说，她害怕被诊断为患有精神病，也不想去精神病院。

sentences.en: By now Annalise had lost her appetite and she was hardly eating at all.
sentences.zh: 此时，安娜莉丝已经失去了胃口，几乎什么也不吃了。

sentences.en: Father Alt being convinced
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父确信

sentences.en: Annalise was possessed by demons started to make arrangements to perform a full-blown exorcism ritual.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝被恶魔附身了，于是开始着手安排进行一场全面的驱魔仪式。

sentences.en: He enlisted the help of Father Renz.
sentences.zh: 他争取到了伦茨神父的帮助。

sentences.en: Father Renz paid several visits to Annalise but he wasn't entirely convinced she was possessed.
sentences.zh: 伦茨神父多次拜访安娜莉丝，但他并不完全确信她被附身了。

sentences.en: During these visits
sentences.zh: 在这些探访期间，

sentences.en: Annalise displayed none of her violent psychotic behaviour and she didn't mention demons at all.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝没有表现出任何暴力精神病行为，也根本没有提到恶魔。

sentences.en: In fact Father Renz described her as seemingly normal, reserved and polite.
sentences.zh: 事实上，伦茨神父形容她看起来很正常、内敛且有礼貌。

sentences.en: Which is unusual because the accounts of Father Alt and the family members say that she was constantly violent, psychotic and when she wasn't she was severely depressed
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常，因为根据阿尔特神父和家属的说法，她一直都有暴力和精神病发作的情况，而在不发作时则严重抑郁，

sentences.en: and still talking about demons.
sentences.zh: 并且还在谈论恶魔。

sentences.en: So there's a clash of accounts there.
sentences.zh: 所以这里存在着说法上的冲突。

sentences.en: But Father Alt himself was convinced that Annalise was possessed and on the 23rd of September 1975 the Bishop Green had permission for a full-blown exorcism ritual
sentences.zh: 但阿尔特神父本人确信安娜莉丝被附身了，于是在1975年9月23日，格林主教批准了一项全面的驱魔仪式，

sentences.en: to be performed on Annalise.
sentences.zh: 将在安娜莉丝身上实施。

sentences.en: The first exorcism ritual was performed the day after permission was granted on the 24th of September 1975.
sentences.zh: 第一场驱魔仪式在批准后的第二天，即1975年9月24日举行。

sentences.en: Father Alt and Father Renz performed the ritual along with Annalise's parents
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父和伦茨神父以及安娜莉丝的父母

sentences.en: Anna and Joseph her boyfriend Peter and her sisters.
sentences.zh: 安娜和约瑟夫、她的男友彼得以及她的姐妹们共同实施了这一仪式。

sentences.en: The ceremony began by sprinkling holy water on Annalise.
sentences.zh: 仪式从向安娜莉丝洒圣水开始。

sentences.en: She reacted violently.
sentences.zh: 她的反应非常激烈。

sentences.en: She roared with rage and screamed put away that shit.
sentences.zh: 她愤怒地咆哮并尖叫着“把那破玩意拿开”。

sentences.en: Annalise had to be held down.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝不得不被人按住。

sentences.en: She tried to kick and bite everyone present.
sentences.zh: 她试图踢打和咬在场的每一个人。

sentences.en: She was growling and hissing making horrific screaMs.
sentences.zh: 她发出低吼和嘶嘶声，发出可怕的尖叫。

sentences.en: All of the prayer readings were done in Latin which Annalise was actually fluent in.
sentences.zh: 所有的经文宣读都是用拉丁语进行的，而安娜莉丝实际上精通拉丁语。

sentences.en: Annalise describes this first ritual as being like a spectator.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝将这第一场仪式描述得就像一个旁观者。

sentences.en: She says it was her body and her voice but she had no control over either of them.
sentences.zh: 她说那是她的身体和她的声音，但她对两者都没有控制权。

sentences.en: She could only look on while the demons that were possessing her controlled her.
sentences.zh: 她只能眼睁睁地看着附在她身上的恶魔控制她。

sentences.en: Many more exorcism rituals were performed after this first one and many of them were recorded.
sentences.zh: 在第一次驱魔仪式之后，又进行了许多场驱魔仪式，其中许多都被记录了下来。

sentences.en: Annalise would go on to say during future sessions that she was possessed by six demons
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝在以后的治疗中会说，她被六个恶魔附身了，

sentences.en: Lucifer,
sentences.zh: 路西法，

sentences.en: Judas,
sentences.zh: 犹大，

sentences.en: Nero,
sentences.zh: 尼禄，

sentences.en: Cain,
sentences.zh: 该隐，

sentences.en: Hitler and Fleischmann.
sentences.zh: 希特勒和弗莱施曼。

sentences.en: Lucifer in fact is the only demon so to speak.
sentences.zh: 事实上，路西法可以说是唯一的恶魔。

sentences.en: The rest were humans.
sentences.zh: 其余的都是人类。

sentences.en: Judas was the disciple of Jesus who ended up betraying him.
sentences.zh: 犹大是最终背叛耶稣的门徒。

sentences.en: Nero was the Roman emperor from the years
sentences.zh: 尼禄是公元
54年至68年的罗马皇帝。

sentences.en: His reign was one of tyranny.
sentences.zh: 他的统治充满了暴政。

sentences.en: He was responsible for murdering his own family members and he had Christians burnt alive.
sentences.zh: 他谋害了自己的家人，还将基督徒活活烧死。

sentences.en: Cain is another person from the Bible and along with his brother Abel they were the sons of Adam and Eve.
sentences.zh: 该隐是圣经中的另一个人物，他和他的兄弟亚伯是亚当和夏娃的儿子。

sentences.en: Cain ended up murdering Abel.
sentences.zh: 该隐最终谋杀了亚伯。

sentences.en: Hitler doesn't need an explanation.
sentences.zh: 希特勒不需要解释。

sentences.en: Fleischmann was a
sentences.zh: 弗莱施曼是16世纪的一名

sentences.en: Catholic priest in the 1500s.
sentences.zh: 天主教神父。

sentences.en: He was accused of murder and excommunicated by the church and he was actually a German prieSt.
sentences.zh: 他被指控谋杀并被教会逐出教会，他实际上是一名德国神父。

sentences.en: Not only was Annalise a devout Catholic she was also very well read.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝不仅是一名虔诚的天主教徒，而且博览群书。

sentences.en: She would read all kinds of books both religious and otherwise and would have had a great deal of knowledge about Lucifer,
sentences.zh: 她阅读各种各样的书，包括宗教的和非宗教的，并且对路西法、

sentences.en: Judas,
sentences.zh: 犹大、

sentences.en: Nero and Cain.
sentences.zh: 尼禄和该隐有着大量的了解。

sentences.en: It's also thought she would have learned about priest Fleischmann in her studies particularly as he was German and then there's the Hitler angle which is obvious.
sentences.zh: 人们还认为，她在学习中一定了解过弗莱施曼神父，特别是他是德国人，然后还有显而易见的希特勒这个角度。

sentences.en: And by now the exorcist novel and movie were worldwide smash hits.
sentences.zh: 而此时，驱魔题材的小说和电影已经风靡全球。

sentences.en: There's no evidence
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明

sentences.en: Annalise read the book or saw the movie but given how big it was at the time and how much
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝读过这本书或看过这部电影，但鉴于它当时的影响力有多大，以及安娜莉丝有多喜欢

sentences.en: Annalise liked to read there's every possibility that Annalise had read the book or seen the movie or both.
sentences.zh: 阅读，完全有可能安娜莉丝读过这本书、看过这部电影，或者两者都看/读过。

sentences.en: Did Annalise's mental illness combine her knowledge of Lucifer,
sentences.zh: 难道是安娜莉丝的精神疾病将她对路西法、

sentences.en: Nero, Cain,
sentences.zh: 尼禄、该隐、

sentences.en: Judas,
sentences.zh: 犹大、

sentences.en: Fleischmann and Hitler with what she had read or seen in the exorcist somehow convincing herself that she was possessed as well?
sentences.zh: 弗莱施曼和希特勒的知识与她在驱魔人中读到或看到的内容结合起来，以某种方式说服了自己，让她也相信自己被附身了吗？

sentences.en: Judas.
sentences.zh: 犹大。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Fleischmann.
sentences.zh: 弗莱施曼。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I was excedent.
sentences.zh: 我当时兴奋极了。

sentences.en: You gave her love.
sentences.zh: 你给了她爱。

sentences.en: I was about to to say enough.
sentences.zh: 我正要说够了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The exorcisms performed on Annalise were horrific.
sentences.zh: 在安娜莉丝身上进行的驱魔仪式极其可怕。

sentences.en: She would scream, her face would contort, her body would violently thrash about.
sentences.zh: 她会尖叫，她的脸会扭曲，她的身体会剧烈抽搐。

sentences.en: She would then stop and go completely rigid and stiff for a period of time before violently exploding again.
sentences.zh: 然后她会停下来，全身僵硬一段时间，接着又剧烈爆发。

sentences.en: Here's an interesting conversation I found during one of the rituals.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个我在其中一次仪式中发现的有趣对话。

sentences.en: Annalise claims she was actually Lucifer at this point in the conversation.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝在对话的这一点声称她实际上就是路西法。

sentences.en: Annalise says, the snot-nosed brat was cursed.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝说，这个乳臭未干的丫头被诅咒了。

sentences.en: She belongs to us.
sentences.zh: 她属于我们。

sentences.en: She's no longer alive.
sentences.zh: 她已经不在人世了。

sentences.en: Father Alt says, is she down with you?
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父说，她跟你一起下去了吗？

sentences.en: Annalise says, no, I have to say everything, therefore the snot-nosed has to pay for it.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝说，没有，我必须把一切都说出来，因此这个乳臭未干的丫头必须为此付出代价。

sentences.en: Father Alt says, you have to get out of her.
sentences.zh: 阿尔特神父说，你必须从她体内离开。

sentences.en: Annalise says, I don't want out yet because I have so much to say.
sentences.zh: 安娜莉丝说，我अभी还不想离开，因为我有太多话要说。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案室继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: This is interesting because if you remember back to when Annalise was in hospital as a 17-year-old, other teenagers in there were giving her a hard time about her condition.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为如果你还记得安娜莉丝17岁住院的时候，那里的其他青少年一直在为难她的病情。

sentences.en: They referred to her as snot-nosed.
sentences.zh: 他们管她叫鼻涕虫（乳臭未干的丫头）。

sentences.en: Some even made fun of her after the episode of sleep paralysis saying she was possessed by the devil.
sentences.zh: 甚至有人在睡眠瘫痪症发作后取笑她，说她被魔鬼附身了。

sentences.en: So was this really the devil possessing Annalise?
sentences.zh: 所以这真的是恶魔附身安娜莉丝吗？

sentences.en: Or was Annalise in a deep, deep stage of psychosis and delusion conjuring up a stressful, unhappy time in her past?
sentences.zh: 还是安娜莉丝正处于极度严重的精神病和妄想阶段，在脑海中唤起了她过去一段充满压力、不愉快的时光？
